description: Gnevoza Rudeevich wears a blue floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and pale geometric woven embroidery around the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, centre and hem. Round shoulder and sleeve clasps and a red-brown decorated woven sash with a round buckle and long tasselled ends secure the layers. A grey-beige fringed wrap with blue geometric borders lies around her forearms. An ivory underdress and brown closed shoes show at the lower opening. A pendant and finger ring are visible. Her crown braids are uncovered.
